mapper.select: SELECT rs.id id, rs.create_time createTime, rs.name name, rs.url url, rs.description description, rs.category_id categoryId FROM ums_admin_role_relation arr LEFT JOIN ums_role r ON arr.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN ums_role_resource_relation rrr ON r.id = rrr.role_id LEFT JOIN ums_resource rs ON rrr.resource_id = rs.id WHERE arr.admin_id = #{adminId} AND r.id IS NOT NULL
